# ChestStealer

**Category:** Player  
**Aliases:** AutoSteal, Chest Stealer, ChestStealer

## What it does

ChestStealer empties chests and other containers for you the moment you open them, shift-clicking (or dragging) every worthwhile item into your inventory in a fraction of a second. It's built for loot runs where speed matters, like grabbing chests on Bedwars, SkyWars, or while raiding bases.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/player/cheststealer). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
